verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a built-in docs search feature, let alone one that is fast, typo-tolerant or relevance-ranked. The only search-related items are a `search-metadata` frontmatter field meant for a custom search integration, and a passing mention that automations can review 'search queries'. Ask Fern is an AI question-answering feature, which is a different capability from site search.

support.subject: As a developer, readers get fast, typo-tolerant, relevance-ranked search over the whole docs site out of the box
